|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Navy Of The First Order]] (version 2 of 2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). [First Order] starships are deploy -1 (-2 to D'Qar) and hyperspeed +1. During your deploy phase, may reveal one [First Order] starship from hand to take a First Order pilot (or vice versa) into hand from Reserve Deck (reshuffle) and deploy both simultaneously. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Navy Of The First Order]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Navy Of The First Order]] (published 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Navy Of The First Order”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
